home.title: SCP: Secret Laboratory Server List: Live Servers and Player Stats
home.description: Browse every public SCP: Secret Laboratory server live. Filter by country, players and mods, and see player trends, rankings and records since 2020.
home.heading: SCP: Secret Laboratory server list
home.intro: Every public SCP: Secret Laboratory server, refreshed once a minute. Filter by country, player count, mods and friendly fire, then open a server to see its player history, its busy hours and its rank.

stats.title: SCP: SL player statistics since 2020
stats.description: How many people play SCP: Secret Laboratory on public servers: daily peaks since 2020, records, the effect of game updates, players by country and mod loader use.
stats.intro: The number of players on public SCP: Secret Laboratory servers, recorded once a minute since September 2020. Compare countries, see what each update did and check today against the record.

map.description: World map of public SCP: Secret Laboratory servers by hosting location. Open a marker to see the server and its player history.
map.intro: Every public SCP: Secret Laboratory server on a world map, placed where it is hosted.

server.description_offline: {{name}} is an SCP: Secret Laboratory server in {{country}} that is offline right now. See its player history and its record.

server.about_vanilla: {{name}} is an unmodded SCP: Secret Laboratory server hosted in {{country}} that runs game version {{version}}.

countries.title: SCP: SL servers by country

countries.description-empty: SCP: Secret Laboratory servers by country: servers online, players and 30-day peaks.
countries.intro: SCP: Secret Laboratory servers are online in {{count}} countries right now. {{first}}, {{second}} and {{third}} draw the most players.
countries.note: A server belongs to the country where it is hosted, which is not always where its players live. The 30-day average covers {{from}} to {{to}} and uses each day's highest number of players online at once.

rankings.title: Top SCP: SL servers: most popular, rising and longest running
rankings.heading: Server rankings
rankings.description: Rankings of the {{total}} SCP: Secret Laboratory servers online now by daily peak players over the last 30 days: most popular, fastest rising, best newcomers and longest running.
rankings.intro: These rankings cover the {{total}} servers that are online now. A server's score is its highest player count of each UTC day, averaged over the last 30 days ({{from}} to {{to}}). A day offline counts as zero, so steady servers rank above short spikes.
rankings.leader: {{name}} leads with an average daily peak of {{average}} players.
rankings.popular-note: Highest average daily peak over the last 30 days.
rankings.rising-note: Biggest gain in average daily peak against the 30 days before. Servers newer than 60 days are left out.
rankings.newcomers-note: Servers first seen in the last 30 days.
rankings.veterans-note: Servers online now that have been in the list the longest.
rankings.description-empty: Rankings of SCP: Secret Laboratory servers by daily peak players over the last 30 days: most popular, fastest rising, best newcomers and longest running.

versions.title: SCP: SL update history: every game version since 2020
versions.heading: Game versions
versions.description: All {{count}} SCP: Secret Laboratory versions seen on public servers since 2020: first-seen dates, player counts before and after, and how fast servers updated. Latest: {{latest}}.
versions.description-empty: Every SCP: Secret Laboratory version seen on public servers since 2020.
versions.intro: {{count}} versions of SCP: Secret Laboratory have reached public servers since our records began in September 2020. The newest is {{latest}}, first seen on {{date}}.
versions.note: A date is the day servers first ran a version, which can be a day off the official release. The player columns compare the median daily peak of the 14 days before and after.

version.title: SCP: SL {{version}}: release date, players and server adoption
version.heading: SCP: SL {{version}}
version.description_impact: SCP: Secret Laboratory {{version}} reached public servers on {{date}}. The daily peak went from {{before}} to {{after}} players ({{change}}). See how fast servers updated.
version.description_plain: SCP: Secret Laboratory {{version}} reached public servers on {{date}}. See how many servers ran it and how fast they updated.
version.first-seen_major: Version {{version}} of SCP: Secret Laboratory, a major update, first ran on public servers on {{date}}.
version.first-seen_minor: Version {{version}} of SCP: Secret Laboratory, a minor update, first ran on public servers on {{date}}.
version.impact_up: In the 14 days after it arrived, the median daily peak was {{after}} players, up {{percent}}% from {{before}} in the 14 days before. Seasons and holidays move these numbers too, so this is not the effect of the update alone.
version.impact_down: In the 14 days after it arrived, the median daily peak was {{after}} players, down {{percent}}% from {{before}} in the 14 days before. Seasons and holidays move these numbers too, so this is not the effect of the update alone.
version.impact_flat: In the 14 days after it arrived, the median daily peak was {{after}} players, the same as in the 14 days before.
version.half_one: It took {{count}} day for half of the active servers to run it.
version.half_other: It took {{count}} days for half of the active servers to run it.
version.half-first-day: Half of the active servers ran it on the first day.
version.half-never: It never ran on half of the active servers.
version.height: At its height on {{date}}, {{servers}} servers ran it, {{share}}% of the servers active that day.
version.gone: No server online now runs it. It was last seen on {{date}}.
version.adoption-note: Servers that ran this version on each day after it arrived, against all servers active that day.

records.title: SCP: SL player count records: all-time peaks by day, year and country
records.heading: Player count records
records.description: The most players ever online on public SCP: Secret Laboratory servers: {{peak}} on {{date}}. Highest days, yearly peaks, the biggest jumps after updates and country records since 2020.
records.description-empty: All-time player count records of public SCP: Secret Laboratory servers since 2020.
records.top_release: The most players ever online at once on public SCP: Secret Laboratory servers is {{peak}}, recorded on {{date}}, around the release of version {{version}}.
records.top_plain: The most players ever online at once on public SCP: Secret Laboratory servers is {{peak}}, recorded on {{date}}.
records.scope: These figures count players on servers in the public server list, read once a minute since {{start}}. Private and unlisted servers are not included, so they run lower than Steam's player count.
records.latest: The latest full day, {{date}}, peaked at {{peak}} players, which ranks #{{rank}} of {{days}} days on record.
records.days-note: The days are at least 10 days apart, so one busy week counts once.

reports.title: SCP: SL server reports: monthly and yearly player statistics
reports.heading: Reports

reports.description-empty: Monthly and yearly reports on public SCP: Secret Laboratory servers since 2020.
reports.intro: Each report sums up one finished month or year on public SCP: Secret Laboratory servers: how many players were online, which countries and servers led, and which updates came out. Days are UTC days.
